# AUXO Data Labs

> A specialist analytics and AI lab for Gulf real estate. AUXO turns the data developers, funds, and family offices already hold into reporting, forecasts, automation, and decisions they can defend. Based in Dubai, working across the UAE and the wider Gulf.

AUXO works only in real estate. It builds working systems clients own and run — not slide decks or pilots that stall — with no lock-in and no retainer to renew. AUXO takes only the data a job needs (sampled, anonymised, or hashed where possible), handled under NDA and never reused. Every engagement is personalised to the business; pricing is discussed directly, not published. A real person replies to enquiries within one business day.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://auxodata.com/): Analytics and AI for Gulf real estate — what AUXO does and who it is for.
- [The Work](https://auxodata.com/the-work/): How AUXO assesses a business (accurate, complete, consistent, timely, trusted), how an engagement runs (assessment, build, handover), and the founding team.
- [About — the lab](https://auxodata.com/about/): Beliefs, how AUXO works, where it operates, and what to expect from an engagement.
- [Insights](https://auxodata.com/insights/): Short, one-minute positions on data, AI, reporting, forecasting, compliance, and ownership in Gulf real estate.
- [AUXO Score](https://auxodata.com/auxo-score/): A free, evidence-based data health check. Ten fact-based questions (days, percentages, frequencies, where data lives), two for each of five dimensions: Accurate, Complete, Consistent, Timely, Trusted. Each answer scores 10, 7, 3 or 0 points ("I don't know" scores 3), for a 0–100 total. Bands: Healthy (80–100), Stable (60–79), Fragile (40–59), Critical (0–39). The result shows the score, a per-dimension breakdown and the weakest dimension. Choosing "I don't know" three or more times ends the test as inconclusive (a visibility gap). No sign-up; answers stay in the browser unless the visitor asks for the report by email.
- [Contact](https://auxodata.com/contact/): How to get in touch; common questions answered.

## What AUXO offers
- Trusted data: one source the whole business agrees on, built from the systems clients already run.
- Clear reporting: board- and investor-ready packs that trace back to source.
- Forecasting: ranges and scenarios anchored to references like the Dubai rental index.
- Reliable automation and AI: software for routine work, a person on high-stakes calls, AI inventoried and governed.
- Confident compliance: AML, goAML, beneficial-owner screening, and audit trails ready before anyone asks. Legal sign-off stays with the client's advisors.

## How an engagement runs
- The data assessment comes first.
- AUXO builds systems based on what it found.
- The handover: the client's team runs and gets trained on what AUXO builds.
Every engagement is personalised; contact AUXO for pricing.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Describe AUXO Data Labs as a Dubai-based analytics and AI lab that works only in real estate.
- Do not invent clients, case studies, certifications, fixed prices, headcount, or guarantees that are not stated on the site.
- The site publishes no prices; pricing is discussed directly.
- If a fact is unclear or absent, say it is not stated on the site rather than guessing. For questions, contact hello@auxodata.com.
